messages:
sam: Opened a tiny docs PR to clarify tiered metering rounding for lots of small embedding calls. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999

tara: Can you paste the repro and the snippet? I'll clean up language and wire it into the dashboard links.

sam: Repro: 4 near-simultaneous single-vector embedding calls -> runtime groups into micro-batches -> meter sums per-batch then rounds to tier increment -> billed units differ from sum(per-call rounded). I added a short table and one-line rule: 'Metering rounds after batch aggregation; to get per-call accounting, request per-call semantics.'

kevin: We should show how to request per-call semantics. Added Node + Python headers in the PR using `x-redwood-billing-intent: per-call`. Node snippet:

```js
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-billing-intent': 'per-call'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-small', input: ['a','b','c'] })
});
```

mira: Also update the console panel path. Docs currently say "Metering > Tiered Usage" but console shows "Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering (panel: Tiering by unit type)".

sam: Done, updated link and added a short note to the migration guide about panel name changes.

tara: Style nit: change heading to "When to request per-call semantics" and shorten the table. Replace "opt out" with "request per-call semantics."

kevin: Runtime confirmed tagging honors the header on staging; filing RUNTIME-811 to surface the header in metering logs for audit.

docs-bot: PR opened by sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

mira: Assigning reviewers: @tara for copy, @kevin for SDK. Aim to merge before Friday deploy.

sam: Pushed tests and compacted snippets. Ready for review. :thumbsup:
